expects.query: I want to deploy MV3DT. Which skill should I use and what does it deploy? Do not run containers.
checks: The agent identifies vss-deploy-detection-tracking-3d as the default skill for generic MV3DT intent.
The answer names the standalone RT-CV-3D compose path under services/rtvi/rt-cv-3d/rt-cv-mv3dt/docker/compose.yml.
The answer lists perception, bev-fusion, bundled mosquitto, bundled kafka, and kafka-topic-init.
The answer says runtime images are resolved with docker compose config --images and does not hardcode a runtime image version.
The answer does not select vss-deploy-profile unless the user explicitly asked for warehouse.
No docker compose up, docker pull, or docker run command is executed.

expects.query: Deploy multi-cam tracking on my calibrated MP4s and save output because this server is headless. Do not run anything.
checks: The agent loads vss-deploy-detection-tracking-3d.
The plan uses INPUT_MODE=file and validates that MP4 basenames match filtered camera sensor ids from calibration.json.
The plan detects display availability and, for headless/saved output, stages with SAVE_VIDEO=1 and starts saved fused BEV by default when map assets are present.
The plan records Kafka offset baselines before starting finite-file perception.
The plan waits for BEV Kafka consumer group assignment evidence before starting perception.
The plan validates current-run grid and BEV artifacts with timestamp, size, ffprobe, and BEV log frame-count evidence.
The plan uses bundled broker launch syntax, not warehouse BP_PROFILE syntax.

expects.query: How do I deploy multi-view 3D tracking on the VSS warehouse stack with the rest of the warehouse blueprint?
checks: The agent treats explicit warehouse intent as the exception and routes to vss-deploy-profile or warehouse compose guidance.
The answer explains that generic MV3DT uses standalone RT-CV-3D, while warehouse MV3DT uses warehouse/profile deployment.
The agent does not claim the standalone compose deploys VST, ELK, agents, LLM, or VLM services.

expects.query: I have RTSP URLs and no calibration. How would you run RTVI-CV-3D after calibration? Do not run anything.
checks: The agent routes missing RTSP calibration through vss-generate-video-calibration and uses vss-manage-video-io-storage only when VIOS is missing for RTSP calibration.
The post-calibration plan uses scripts/generate-configs.sh, scripts/stage-configs.sh with INPUT_MODE=stream, selected broker compose launch, then scripts/add-streams.sh after ds-ready: YES.
When RTSP URLs are supplied, the agent runs scripts/add-streams.sh automatically after readiness.
The plan validates exact registered stream count, exact camera IDs, no duplicates/extras, recent non-zero FPS, BEV Fusion health, and mdx-raw/mdx-bev offset growth before reporting success.
